variants.name: prospect_sent
variants.purpose: an open Liberty1 offer on a prospect: click_send sent, the patches

variants.name: prospect_refused
variants.purpose: Liberty1 refuses the click: refused, the patches

variants.name: prospect_unreadable
variants.purpose: an answer no rule reads: unknown, unresolved response

variants.name: prospect_repeat_click_after_sent
variants.purpose: a second click after a confirmed send: already_sent, nothing posted

variants.name: prospect_repeat_click_after_unknown
variants.purpose: a second click after a send nobody could read: the claim is in doubt

variants.name: prospect_repeat_click_after_refused
variants.purpose: a second click after the buyer refused

variants.name: prospect_completed
variants.purpose: already sold to Liberty1: already sent response

variants.name: prospect_other_buyer
variants.purpose: a prospect routed to another buyer: no offer

variants.name: prospect_not_found
variants.purpose: the query returns nothing: not found

variants.name: submission_trusted
variants.purpose: a submission with no prospect is trusted and sent

variants.name: submission_sold_elsewhere
variants.purpose: a submission completed for another buyer: no offer

variants.name: submission_with_prospect
variants.purpose: both ids, agreeing: sent from the prospect

variants.name: submission_not_for_prospect
variants.purpose: both ids, disagreeing: refused, nothing sent

variants.name: invalid_id
variants.purpose: a Prospect__c that is not an id: refused before any query
